metadata.scenario: An insurance policyholder wants to follow up on their claim status and expected processing time. Category: Follow-up.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I’m calling to follow up on my insurance claim status. Hi Betty, it’s great to hear from you! Let me pull up your information. One moment, please. Okay, I see your claim for fall prevention and mobility assistance services. Can you remind me when you submitted it? I submitted it about two weeks ago. I just wanted to check on the processing time. Thanks for that. Typically, claims take about 14 to 21 days to process. So, it’s still within that timeframe? Yes, exactly. However, I can check with our billing department for any updates. That would be helpful. I’m a bit anxious since I rely on these services. I completely understand. Your care is important to us. I’ll follow up with billing right after our call. Thank you, I appreciate that. I also want to discuss my last visit. Of course! Your last visit was four days ago. How did it go for you? It was good, but I think I could benefit from some additional physical therapy sessions. We can certainly arrange that. Dr. Rodriguez is available for physical therapy during the week. Great! Can you schedule me for that? Absolutely. How many sessions would you like to start with? Let’s start with two sessions a week, if possible. That’s doable. I’ll set that up for you. And about my claim, do you think it’ll be processed soon? I’ll prioritize it with billing and should have an update for you by tomorrow. Thank you so much, Margaret. That really puts my mind at ease. You’re very welcome, Betty. Is there anything else I can help you with today? No, that’s all for now. Thank you again for your help! My pleasure! I’ll follow up on your claim and schedule your therapy sessions. Sounds perfect. Have a great day! You too, Betty! Take care.
